$comment: Canonical governance record for the GDS vendor UI engine (issue #348). The engine is a peer dependency (single resolved instance). Upgrades are deliberate internal migrations behind the stable public contract enforced by `npm run verify:boundary`; consumers are unaffected. Update this file only via the documented runbook (docs/VENDOR_UPGRADE_RUNBOOK.md).
notes: Engine stays a peer for single-instance safety. A candidate major is smoke-tested by the CI matrix before adoption; adoption changes only adapter/seam files behind GDS's owned public contract.
$mapComment: Issue 566. Leaflet, not MapLibre GL JS: ~40KB minified against several hundred, no WebGL requirement (which matters for forced-colors and low-end devices), and raster tiles are sufficient because vector-tile styling is out of scope. MapLibre would be right if themed vector basemaps were required. Recorded so a future reversal is a decision rather than a rediscovery. Pinned EXACTLY rather than by range: a map engine renders third-party tiles and holds imperative DOM, so a silent minor bump is not something to find out about from a broken map.
